sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: I'm very pleased to have this opportunity to say a little about two exciting new developments in the city: the Brackenside Open-Air Swimming Pool and the children's Adventure Playground in Central Park.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴有机会向大家简要介绍本市两项令人振奋的新建项目：布拉肯赛德露天游泳池和中央公园儿童冒险游乐场。

sentences.en: As many of you may know, the idea for these initiatives came from you, the public, in the extensive consultation exercise which the City Council conducted last year.
sentences.zh: 在座的许多朋友可能已经知道，这些项目的构想源自各位市民——即去年市议会开展的广泛公众咨询活动。

sentences.en: And they have been realised using money from the SWRDC- the South West Regional Development Commission.
sentences.zh: 这些项目资金来自西南地区发展委员会（SWRDC）。

sentences.en: First of all, Brackenside Pool.
sentences.zh: 首先，介绍一下布拉肯赛德游泳池。

sentences.en: As many of the older members of the audience will remember, there used to be a wonderful open-air pool on the sea front 30 years ago but it had it to close when it was judged to be unsafe.
sentences.zh: 在座年长些的听众或许还记得，三十年前海滨曾有一座极佳的露天泳池，但后来因被判定为不安全而被迫关闭。

sentences.en: For the design of this new heated pool, we were very happy to secure the talents of internationally renowned architect Ellen Wendon, who has managed to combine a charming 1930s design, which fits in so well with many of the other buildings in the area, with up-to-the-minute features such as a recycling system - the only one of its kind in the world - which enables seawater to be used in the pool.
sentences.zh: 这座新建的恒温泳池由国际知名建筑师艾伦·温登女士担纲设计，我们非常荣幸能邀请到她。她成功地将迷人典雅的1930年代建筑风格——这种风格与本地区众多其他建筑极为协调——与最前沿的设施融为一体，例如全球独一无二的海水循环系统，使泳池得以直接使用海水。

sentences.en: Now, there has been quite a bit of discussion in the local press about whether there would be enough room for the number of visitors we're hoping to attract, but the design is deceptive and there have been rigorous checks about capacity.
sentences.zh: 近期本地媒体曾就泳池能否容纳我们预期吸引的游客数量展开过不少讨论，但该设计颇具迷惑性，且我们已对承载容量进行了严格核查。

sentences.en: Also, just in case you were wondering, we're on schedule for a June 15th opening date and well within budget: a testimony to the excellent work of local contractors Hickman's.
sentences.zh: 另外，若您有所疑虑，目前工程进度完全符合计划，将于6月15日正式开放，且预算控制良好——这充分体现了本地承包商希克曼公司卓越的工作成效。

sentences.en: We hope that as many people as possible will be there on June 15th.
sentences.zh: 我们诚挚希望尽可能多的市民能于6月15日莅临现场。

sentences.en: We have engaged award-winning actress Coral White to declare the pool open and there'll be drinks and snacks available at the pool side.
sentences.zh: 我们已邀请屡获殊荣的女演员科拉尔·怀特女士为泳池揭幕，届时泳池边还将提供饮品与小食。

sentences.en: There'll also a be a competition for the public to decide on the sculpture we plan to have at the entrance: you will decide which famous historical figure from the city we should have.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还将举办一场面向公众的竞赛，由大家投票决定入口处雕塑所刻画的城市著名历史人物。

sentences.en: And now, moving on to the Central Park Playground, which we're pleased to announce has just won the Douglas Award for safety: the news came through only last week.
sentences.zh: 接下来，让我们转向中央公园游乐场——我们很高兴地宣布，该游乐场刚刚荣获道格拉斯安全奖，这一喜讯上周才正式公布。

sentences.en: The unique design is based on the concept of the Global Village, with the playground being divided into six areas showing different parts of the world - each with a representative feature.
sentences.zh: 其独特设计以‘地球村’概念为基础，整个游乐场划分为六个区域，分别展现世界不同地域，并各具代表性特色。

sentences.en: For example, there is a section on Asia, and this is represented by rides and equipment in the shape of snakes, orang-utans, tigers and so on - fauna native to the forests of the region.
sentences.zh: 例如，亚洲区以蛇、红毛猩猩、老虎等当地森林原生动物为造型，设置各类滑梯与游乐设施。

sentences.en: Moving south to the Antarctic - we couldn't run to an ice rink I'm afraid but opted instead for climbing blocks in the shape of mountains - I thought they could have had slides for the glaciers but the designers did want to avoid being too literal!
sentences.zh: 再往南至南极洲区——很抱歉我们未能建造溜冰场，而是选择了山形攀爬块；我原本以为可以设计成冰川滑梯，但设计师们希望避免过于直白的表达！

sentences.en: Then on to South America and here the theme is El Dorado - games replicating the search for mines full of precious stones.
sentences.zh: 接着是南美洲区，主题为‘黄金国’（El Dorado），通过游戏模拟探寻盛产宝石的矿藏。

sentences.en: And then moving up to North America, here there was considerable debate - know the contribution of cinema and jazz was considered but the designers finally opted for rockets and the International Space Station.
sentences.zh: 随后北上至北美洲区，此处曾引发相当激烈的讨论——曾考虑过电影与爵士乐的贡献，但最终设计师选定火箭与国际空间站作为主题。

sentences.en: Eastwards to Europe then, and perhaps the most traditional choice of all the areas: medieval castles and other fortifications.
sentences.zh: 再向东进入欧洲区，这或许是所有区域中最为传统的一个：以中世纪城堡及其他防御工事为特色。

sentences.en: Then last, but not least, moving south to Africa and a whole set of wonderful mosaics and trails to represent the great rivers of this fascinating and varied continent.
sentences.zh: 最后，但同样重要的是非洲区，这里设有大量精美的马赛克图案与步道，用以呈现这片充满魅力且多元化的大陆上伟大的河流。

sentences.en: Now, the opening date for our Global Playground is 10th July.
sentences.zh: 我们的‘地球村’游乐场将于7月10日正式开放。

sentences.en: And again we'd love to see you there - a so make a date and come and see this magnificent, original new amenity right in the heart of the city.
sentences.zh: 我们再次热忱期待您的光临——请务必记下日期，前来欣赏这座宏伟而富有创意的新设施，它就坐落于本市正中心。
